title.narrative: IMPROVED QUALITY OF CARE FROM PREGNANCYTO ADOLESCENCE FOR Maternal, Neonatal, and Child Health (MNCH) AND HIV

description.narrative: Health systems provide improved quality of care from pregnancy to adolescence for Maternal, Neonatal, and Child Health (MNCH) and HIV.

participating-org.narrative: ACTION POUR LE DEVELOPPEMENT DU PEUPLE ADEPE
NATIONAL CHILD DEVELOPMENT AGENCY TUBARERE MUMURYANGO PROGRAMME
RWANDA INTERFAITH COUNCIL ON HEALTH RICH
STATE OF MD UNIVERSITY OF MARYLAND
UPHLS UMBRELLA OF ORGANIZATIONS OF PERSONS
YOUNG WOMEN S CHRISTIAN ASSOCIATION OF RWANDA YWCA RWANDA

mailing-address.narrative: UNICEF Rwanda, EBENEZER House, 1370 Umuganda Boulevard Kacyiru, Kigali Rwanda

description.narrative: Rwanda
Bugesera
Gasabo
Gatsibo

sector.narrative: Child and Adolescent Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) through primary health care
ECD – Parenting support (including gender responsive parenting) to promote responsive care and early stimulation
Facility based maternal and newborn care (including emergency obstetric and newborn care, quality improvement)
HIV Prevention programs for adolescents, including key populations; including for condom programming, VMMC, harm reduction, PreP and sexuality education
HIV testing and counselling including EID, POC EID, PITC, ANC testing, Self testing, Retesting and Family based testing
HSS - Health sector policy, planning and governance at national or sub-national levels
Implementation of community based integrated prevention and management of childhood illnesses (e.g. iCCM)

Programme support for PMTCT including for triple elimination, viral load monitoring, retention in care, infant feeding, PreP among HIV-negative women and negative partners, family planning and partner testing
Treatment for PMTCT and infant ARV prophylaxis
